description: This course will tackle two important topics that underpin a lot of the mathematical machinery to understand modern mathematics, physics, and astronomy. These two being integration and vectors and their calculus. Understanding the concepts that will be discussed in this course requires knowledge and at least an intermediate mastery of the topics discussed in the CAL01 course, i.e., limits and differentiation. A rigorous treatment will only be for certain topics that require it but will not be implemented in the entirety of the course. Multiple readings of the material in advance are highly expected from the student, if not required.
references: Love, C. E., & Rainville, E. D. (1969). Differential and Integral Calculus, 6th ed. The Macmillan Company.
